_README: Customer photos / unboxing reels shown in the #InkAndChaiBookstagram strip on EVERY product page. VIDEOS ARE HOSTED ON SUPABASE STORAGE (public 'reels' bucket), NOT in this repo — this keeps Netlify video bandwidth at zero. To add a reel: drop the .mp4 into ./newvideos, run `node scripts/upload-reels.mjs`, then add an entry below with the printed src URL. Schema at the bottom.

items.caption: What I Talk About When I Talk About Running · Murakami

_schema.src: Full https:// URL. Videos MUST be a Supabase Storage public URL (or any external CDN) — never a /videos/ path in this repo, or it burns Netlify bandwidth.
_schema.poster: Optional thumbnail URL shown in the strip before the reel opens. Leave '' to show a branded play tile.
_schema.caption: 1-line caption shown over the reel
_schema.instagram: Optional Instagram permalink — adds a 'View on Instagram' chip
